Savorum is a free, open-source recipe manager. Import recipes, organize books, plan meals, build shopping lists, and cook with timers. Print recipes or export them with photos in SREF.
[Explore Savorum](https://savorum.app/) · [Installation guide](https://github.com/savorum/unraid-templates/blob/main/README.md) · [Get help](https://savorum.app/contact/)
